newsitem.title: ITALY: INA, Dexia buying one pct stakes in Paolo.
newsitem.headline: INA, Dexia buying one pct stakes in Paolo.

text.p: Italian insurer INA and Franco-Belgian bank group DEXIA are each to acquire one percent stakes in Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino, a statement issued by the bank on Thursday said.

A statement said that following the sale of stakes in the bank to the two companies and to German insurance company HDI, announced earlier in the day, Gruppo Bancario San Paolo Spa's shareholding in the bank would fall to around 43.5 percent from around 46.5 percent.
Gruppo Bancario, in turn owned by a foundation, is the controlling stakeholder in the bank.
None of the three banks would be part of a core of stable shareholders that has been assembled by the bank.

A group of strategic shareholders in Istituto Bancario San Paolo has already been formed including Italy's IFI spa IMI, Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena and insurer Reale Mutua di Assicurazioni with a combined shareholding of 20 percent.
In a second phase a further 25 percent of Istituto Bancario San Paolo will be floated.
Earlier in the day Belgium's Kredietbank said it had taken two percent of Istituto Bancario.
